changelog.notes: Released, after an independent audit of every card against its source.
Retired the GitHub Spark primer: it never said what Spark is, and no saved GitHub Docs page defines it.

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 598 cards against the GitHub Docs pages they quote, found word for word by the card checker
checks.result: Two explanations whose letters did not follow a moved answer were re-lettered; two command cards whose evidence quoted the wrong table were re-sourced; 3 unsupported, 2 ambiguous and 6 unclear cards and 27 minor issues also fixed, and one duplicate deleted.

checks.what: The saved GitHub Docs pages were searched for a passage that says what GitHub Spark is
checks.result: None does (the plans and policy pages only name it), so the Spark primer was retired; no other card uses the term.

openReviews: trademark review of the exam owner's names
data-flow and retention facts rest on 2025 Microsoft Learn units: recheck before release
